title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop a high-performance web dashboard displaying real-time tide curves, swell heights, wave periods, and wind categorization for surf breaks.
latestMessage: Develop a high-performance web dashboard displaying real-time tide curves, swell heights, wave periods, and wind categorization for surf breaks.

steps.title: Integrate NOAA tide API data source
steps.instruction: Implement a service layer to fetch and parse astronomical tide height predictions and hourly water level observations from the NOAA CO-OPS API for designated surf spots.
steps.acceptance: Service successfully parses tide heights, times, and datums into a standardized internal JSON schema with 100% test coverage.

steps.title: Calculate swell height and direction components
steps.instruction: Implement vector math utilities to decompose raw wave watch swell heights, primary swell directions, and wind waves into granular surf metrics.
steps.acceptance: Component decomposition utility returns direction vectors and heights validated against historical wave datasets.

steps.title: Implement responsive SVG-based wave height and tide curve charting
steps.instruction: Create a frontend charting component using SVG to plot overlapping datasets: the 24-hour tide curve, predicted swell heights, and optimal surf windows.
steps.acceptance: Chart component renders fluidly on mobile and desktop viewports, with functional hover tooltips displaying precise tide level metrics.

steps.title: Develop localized wind condition categorization engine
steps.instruction: Build a classification helper that compares wind direction angles against break-specific orientation metadata to classify local wind as offshore, onshore, or cross-shore.
steps.acceptance: Engine categorizes wind vectors into surf quality ratings of 'Good', 'Fair', or 'Poor' based on configured break thresholds.

steps.title: Add local caching layer for API requests
steps.instruction: Configure a local caching mechanism for high-latency external API calls to minimize response times and prevent rate-limiting.
steps.acceptance: Repeated requests for the same surf forecast resolve from cache within 10ms, with a TTL set to 3600 seconds.
